definition: One row per acquisition file. `coverage` is the min/max of the temporal column that file actually carries; `acquisition.status: not-recorded` means no bronze_manifest key matches the file (by name or stem), not that it is unused. `acquisition.rowsMatch` compares the manifest's recorded row count with the measured one. The ledger reports the files present; it does not check them against a separate expected-asset list.
scope: RS01 data-sources inventory, measured from this checkout
